fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-01-10 (night, 00:10): The complainant received messages threatening to circulate private material online unless Rs. 25,000 was paid. The complaint refers to Murugan Babu, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000070. The complainant alleged that Rajesh Karuppasamy may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000318. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00131, as the mobile number 9000000318 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly used online messages to demand money.
fields.Keywords: blackmail, online threat, suspect, night, residential colony, associate, mobile number
